prompt: Subject: Mid-air jump with black pleats Subject: A 20-something woman jumping high in a bluish outdoor setting with arms and legs spread wide. Full body in mid-air placed large in the center, featuring a black thin-strap top, pleated skirt, and loafers. Person/Expression: Slender oval face with a small jaw, sharp dark brown eyes, thin eyebrows, clear nose, and pale lips. Serious expression looking sharply in the direction of travel, facing right. Hair nearly black in a high ponytail, spread wide to the upper left by the momentum of the jump, with thin bangs remaining. Clothing/Pose: Black thin-strap cropped top and black high-waisted short pleated skirt. Black knee-high socks, thick-soled black leather loafers. Arms extended horizontally to the sides in mid-air. Right leg bent high forward, left leg bent back, in a jumping pose with both feet completely off the ground. Background/Light: Background of blue-gray blurred mountains/forest, diagonal power lines and street lamps, with metal and glass buildings at the bottom. Soft diffused light from a cloudy sky applied from the front-top, maintaining the three-dimensionality of the skin and black outfit while giving the whole image a cold blue tone. Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical. Telephoto-style camera looking up from a low position to capture the full body in the air. The person is placed large in the center, arms near the edges, ponytail at the top left, and bent legs in the bottom half. Sharp focus on the person, with a shallow depth of field greatly blurring the background. Texture/Style: Photorealistic live-action photo capturing frozen motion at high speed. Detailed depiction of individual hair strands spreading, the fluttering of pleats, reflections on black fabric and leather shoes, and the cold air. Negative: Change in the mid-air pose with limbs spread; omission of the pleated skirt.

promptZh: 主体：空中跳跃与黑色百褶裙。主体：一位 20 多岁 的女性在蓝调户外环境中高高跃起，四肢舒展。全身处于画面中心，身着黑色细肩带上衣、百褶裙和乐福鞋。人物/表情：修长的鹅蛋脸，下颌小巧，深棕色双眼锐利，眉毛纤细，鼻梁挺拔，双唇苍白。表情严肃，目光锐利地看向移动方向，面朝右侧。近乎黑色的头发扎成高马尾，因跳跃的惯性向左上方散开，留有稀疏的刘海。服装/姿势：黑色细肩带短款上衣和黑色高腰短款百褶裙。黑色过膝袜，厚底黑色皮质乐福鞋。双臂在空中向两侧水平伸展。右腿高高向前弯曲，左腿向后弯曲，双脚完全离地的跳跃姿势。背景/光影：背景为蓝灰色模糊的山脉/森林，有斜向的电线和路灯，底部为金属和玻璃建筑。来自阴天天空的柔和漫射光从前上方照射，在保持皮肤和黑色服装立体感的同时，赋予整个画面冷蓝色调。构图/摄影：3:4 竖构图。长焦风格，从低角度仰拍，捕捉空中全身姿态。人物置于画面中心，双臂靠近边缘，马尾辫位于左上角，弯曲的双腿位于下半部分。焦点清晰地对准人物，浅景深使背景大幅虚化。质感/风格：写实风格的真人照片，定格高速运动瞬间。细腻描绘了散开的发丝、百褶裙的飘动、黑色布料和皮鞋上的反光，以及冷冽的空气感。负面提示词：改变四肢舒展的空中姿势；省略百褶裙。
